title: T12b: local HTTP/WebSocket service for the Rig
head: codex/t12b-local-service
body:
## What

Loopback-only aiohttp 3.13.3 service in agent-core.
Matches desktop-app docs/local-api.md paths and payloads:
status/glow, sign-in, auth status, pause GET/POST,
connector list/connect/status, log path, chat WebSocket stream.
Refuses non-127.0.0.1 binds.
Writes the per-user port file with safe fallback.

Auth (decision #39):
token from SecretStore, keychain service OASIS, account rig.service_token.
HTTP `Authorization: Bearer <token>`;
WebSocket protocols `["bearer", token]`, server checks the second and echoes "bearer".
Token never in URLs, logs, responses or errors.
Pairs with merged desktop-app#3.

Watcher (decision #41, supersedes #40):
starts without a watcher backend;
real in-process pause/glow state;
writes "watcher: not connected" to the activity log at startup;
optional WatcherBackend seam for T05.
Fake backends only in tests.

Clock:
rig-service wires the real T15 SkillClock (skills from `<drawer>/skills` or `--skills-dir`).
POST /pause calls set_paused; shutdown stops it.

Launcher:
`rig-service --drawer <path> --agent <id> [--person <id>] [--catalog-dir <path>] [--skills-dir <path>] [--clock-poll-seconds 30] [--port 4405] [--port-file <path>]`
Startup errors print a generic message; arbitrary exceptions are never formatted.

Files:
src/anorak/local_service.py, local_service_auth.py, local_service_adapters.py, service_cli.py;
tests/test_local_service.py, tests/test_service_cli.py;
docs/local-service.md;
pyproject.toml, uv.lock (uv-generated);
CHANGELOG.md.

Fixed two bugs found while testing the earlier draft:
the chat loop's done_when checker never accepted a successful result (chat always failed);
startup failure cleanup closed the listening socket twice.

## Checks (rerun by coordinator)

- pytest -q → 361 passed, 2 skipped, 1 deselected
- ruff check . → All checks passed; ruff format --check . → 62 files already formatted
- mypy --strict src → no issues in 31 files (native and --platform win32)
- git diff --check → clean

## Known limits

- The clock's LoopRunner has no real skill tools registered yet, so an installed skill whose tool is not registered fails its run closed (visible error, not silent). Registering skill tools is a later ticket.
- No agreed drawer skills-directory convention yet; default is `<drawer>/skills`.
- T11 sign-in runs on a blocking thread with no cancel handle; shutdown waits for it.
- profile.yaml preferences.models.routes.*.secret_name trips T09's secret-key validator (existing T08/T09 conflict); worked around in a test fixture only, not fixed here.
- This PR and agent-core#9 both add a CHANGELOG Unreleased line; whichever merges second needs a one-line rebase.

## Pending (human)

- Windows install
- real keychain and live Microsoft/Google sign-in on Braden's machine
- T05 watcher remains draft pending a Windows box
